entries.note: from SDK matrix core-ai.json Refreshed 2026-10-17: Remaining: no on-device model runtime (load, specialize, run), no compute stream API, no model cache, no inference tracing; the AI features use the cloud API. Built 2026-10-17 (wave 13): core_ai.rs, the inference session over typed functions, the compile step and the specialization cache.
entries.ready_note: Built 2026-10-17 (wave 13): core_ai::InferenceSession loads a model once, compiles its plan for the target into the specialization cache (reused on the next load, purgeable or persistent), checks every call against the typed function signature (named float32 array inputs, outputs) and runs the CPU evaluator, returning the output as an NDArray. Model download state is model_assets, ordered work with dependencies is work_stream. The runtime evaluates dense, relu and softmax chains on the CPU; there is no Neural Engine on this platform and no large-model or GPU kernel runtime.

On BifrOSt the kernel ALSA rawmidi and sequencer layers are the drivers, read by the bifrost-midid server (springboard/audio/midid), so no driver plug-in loader is offered.
